project_info.theme: Luxury party editorial contact sheet with direct flash
project_info.format: one 3x3 portrait contact sheet with nine consistent panels
project_info.color_palette: warm tungsten, direct-flash white, deep wood browns, velvet reds, black leather, and champagne highlights

main_subject.detail: same adult woman in every panel, long dark hair with curtain bangs and slightly tousled party styling, party-glam makeup with bold liner, lashes, warm blush, and nude-pink glossy lips
main_subject.wardrobe: black leather corset mini dress with structured construction and glossy leather texture, gold chain necklaces, small bracelet, and optional small black clutch
main_subject.style: late-1990s and early-2000s party editorial with realistic proportions and consistent identity

composition_elements.layout: 3 rows by 3 columns, thin gutters, no outer border, high panel consistency
composition_elements.panels: vary full-body, three-quarter, mid-shot, and tight portrait framing while maintaining the same adult identity, hairstyle, wardrobe, and environment
directions: full-body standing pose with one hand near the neck
three-quarter pose near a velvet sofa with a relaxed hand-to-hair gesture
full-body wall pose with a slight fashion stance and visible flash shadow
mid-shot playful blown kiss, non-sexual editorial expression
tight portrait with eyes closed or looking down and a hand near the collarbone
mid-shot smiling or laughing with relaxed shoulders
three-quarter walking candid with a hand adjusting hair and no motion blur
full-body fashion stance near a gray event-wall corner with boots visible
mid-shot leaning into frame with a confident gaze and leather highlights

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: hard direct on-camera flash mixed with warm 2800K candle sconces and tungsten room light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: short crisp wall shadows, specular highlights on leather and jewelry, realistic flash falloff, slight exposure variation, mild halation, and authentic party-candid atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: 35mm party-film editorial photographed with a full-frame camera and 35mm lens, eyes sharp, photorealistic
technical_specs.finish: visible true film grain, medium-high contrast, mild color fade, subtle vignette, tiny dust specks, no modern HDR

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create one 3x3 contact sheet, nine panels, with the SAME clearly adult woman identity in every panel. Use a late-90s/early-2000s party editorial vibe, direct on-camera flash, and a candid luxury nightlife mood. The adult woman has long dark hair with curtain bangs, slightly tousled party hair, bold liner, lashes, warm blush, nude-pink glossy lips, and wears the same black leather corset mini dress with structured construction and glossy leather texture, gold chain necklaces, a small bracelet, and an optional small black clutch in every panel. Set the contact sheet in a French chateau interior or vintage lounge with wood paneling, ornate frames, velvet sofa, candle sconces, rich textures, and occasional gray event-wall corner; keep shallow real-party background clutter. Use hard frontal flash with fast falloff, short crisp shadows, realistic wall shadow, and highlights on leather and jewelry. Vary full-body, 3/4, mid-shot, and tight portrait framing across nine panels: standing, leaning near sofa, wall stance, playful blown kiss, looking down with hand near collarbone, laughing, walking candid, event-wall fashion stance, and leaning into frame. Keep the mood confident, playful, and editorial without sexual posing. Photograph with a 35mm lens, sharp eyes, 4:5 portrait layout, true film grain, mild halation, slight color fade, subtle vignette, and no text, logos, watermark, or HDR look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, eroticized expression, ambiguous age, studio beauty lighting, cinematic rim light, HDR ultra-crisp digital look, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped face, uneven eyes, melted mouth, text, logo

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The adult person and wardrobe references are required for identity and outfit continuity; the location reference is optional. Keep the same approved adult identity, hair, dress, jewelry, direct-flash treatment, and nine-panel continuity. The subject identity may be replaced only with another approved adult; the room, sofa, and event-wall details are replaceable. Preserve the non-sexual editorial gestures and remove any accidental text, logo, or watermark.

changes: Clarified the subject as a clearly adult woman and replaced the source's sultry framing with confident, playful editorial direction while preserving the outfit, contact-sheet structure, and poses.
